name: (Cryptid, Experimental) Clobber
text: The experimental cryptid Strikes a creature. On a hit, the creature is pushed 5 feet (10 feet on a critical hit) and knocked Prone. If this causes the creature to collide with a solid object, the creature takes an additional 1d10 untyped damage. If the experimental cryptid is at least 5th level, this Strike deals one additional weapon damage die of damage, and if the experimental cryptid is at least 15th level, this Strike deals two additional weapon damage dice of damage.
